This uses "Payments for property and equipment" of $23,783m (2025), $20,606m (2024) and $16,857m (2023) (total $61,246m) and "Net sales" of $674,538m (2025), $642,637m (2024) and $605,536m (2023, derived from the 6.1% comparable-period change), giving 61,246 / 1,922,711 = 3.2%. The calculation is based on the filing rows labeled "Payments for property and equipment" and "Net sales."
